A professional restoration service designed to improve the look and clarity of headlights affected by oxidation and daily exposure.

Over time, headlights can become cloudy, yellowed, or faded due to sunlight, weather, and regular driving conditions.

Headlight Restoration at HyperAuto Care helps improve the appearance of damaged lenses by removing surface oxidation and restoring clearer visibility.

Instead of replacing the entire headlight assembly, restoration can be a practical option to refresh older headlights and improve the overall look of your vehicle.

Is Headlight Restoration Right For Your Vehicle?

  • Restore headlights that have lost clarity after years of exposure.

  • Help improve headlights affected by long-term sunlight and weather exposure.

  • Improve the appearance of headlights with visible oxidation or fading.

  • Refresh your vehicle’s appearance and improve overall presentation.
